scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web,ml -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/web" "npm run ml:dev"
scripts.dev:node: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.seed: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run seed -w apps/api
scripts.postinstall: (npx --yes prisma generate --schema=prisma/schema.prisma || true) && (npm run ml:setup || true)
